config.caveat: The public EU-legislation legal-BERT base uncased encoder is the closest local match to Sun's bert-legal-uncased family, but it is not claimed to be Sun's exact checkpoint. Only the linear head is trained; the encoder is frozen.
config.reproduction_class: closest available public legal-BERT encoder frozen; two-layer MLP probe trained locally on clean official train split; full CPU fine-tuning not attempted
